title: Department of Commerce Announces Finalization of CHIPS R&D Award with Atom Computing Inc.
html:
WASHINGTON, D.C. — The U.S. Department of Commerce’s CHIPS Research and Development Office announced today the signing of a final R&D award under the CHIPS and Science Act of up to $100 million to Atom Computing, a neutral-atom quantum computing company. The R&D funded by this award will accelerate several strategic R&D initiatives for the development of semiconductors and related technology supporting utility scale, commercially useful neutral-atom-based quantum computers, including hardware development and systems integration needed to manipulate, control, and address tens of thousands of qubits, and validate their performance.

Click here to download the PDF version of this press release.
summary: The grant backs the firm's neutral-atom quantum systems.
